verdict.rationale: Runloop is sandbox infrastructure for running your own AI agents. A first-party in-product assistant is a fair question for a SaaS platform, but the evidence shows no built-in assistant in the dashboard or CLI that users can hand tasks to. The Agents API, agent mounts, Cursor rules files and the MCP server are either building blocks for hosting your own or third-party agents, or context for external assistants. None of them is a built-in delegation assistant.
